ceu: ✦ The trine between the Moon and Venus at {H:1797370349000}

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The trine between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The trine between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The trine between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The trine between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.

The trine between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The trine between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The trine between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, routine and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The trine between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The trine between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Make a family recipe and share it.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The trine between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Turn off notifications for an hour and notice the calm that follows.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The trine between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, money and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Keep a coin in a special place as a symbol of your prosperity.

t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The trine between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Take five minutes when you wake up to decide how you want to feel today.
